title: "I ask for blessings": Gogo pleads with AI ghost in hilarious TikTok prank
key_facts: A South African grandmother was tricked by her granddaughter with an AI ghost filter in a TikTok prank, shared on 6 Oct 2026.
The grey AI ghost had huge eyes, long grey hair and a wide grin; the grandmother did not know it was a filter.
Instead of fleeing, she clasped her hands in prayer or pleading and spoke to the ghost in a South African language.
She told her granddaughter, in complete seriousness, that the ghost was a Tokoloshe.
The Tokoloshe, from Zulu and Xhosa folklore, can be summoned by witches or enemies to cause harm, illness or misfortune.
The TikTok clip had 19.4K likes when the article was written.
quote_evidence: A South African grandmother became an unlikely TikTok star after her granddaughter pulled a ghost filter prank on her.
The granddaughter burst out laughing. The gogo did not.
why_it_matters_hint: A light viral prank with a folklore touch; no effect beyond entertainment.
